reply: This spot check does not provide evidence regarding translation quality across all nine languages. It covers only French, German, and Spanish. Among those three, bilingual reviewers rated average accuracy at 4.6 out of 5, with 3 of 60 articles needing correction. The primary limitation is that the other six languages—including Japanese, Arabic, and Polish—were excluded from this review, meaning conclusions cannot be drawn for the full set of languages.

This spot check cannot report on translation quality across all nine languages. The review covered only French, German, and Spanish; the other six languages, including Japanese, Arabic, and Polish, were not checked.

Among the three languages tested, the average accuracy rating was 4.6 out of 5, with 3 of 60 articles needing correction.

**Critical Limitation:** Since more than half of our published languages were excluded from this check, these findings cannot be applied to the overall translation quality across all nine languages.
